note: Place strings decided by hand, each with its reason. Read by tools/build-tree-page.py; a string already placed through data/era-ground.tsv is not overridden. Nothing is accepted from the Atlas by name alone: a string that era-ground.tsv refuses (a country only, a ship, a journey) stays unresolved.

Benevento.name: Benevento
Benevento.how: data/era-ground.tsv reads this string as Benevento city (its row says «Benevento city and its enclave were papal until 1860»); it has no town there only because the region (Campania, Two Sicilies) would be the wrong era. The point and id are the Record Atlas's own place 'benevento' (41.13, 14.7786, IT); its country is the Atlas's geo.country_of on that point.
